title: Harden repository step 13 against accidental complexity
objective: Refine repository step 13 through an accepted architecture decision so dependency, public-surface, reverse-fan-out and exception governance begins with a current-main complexity remeasurement, inventories equivalent rule-bypass forms, and adopts calibrated simplification budgets before any structural refactor.
deliverables: ADR-031 formally refines repository step 13 under the architecture plan change-control rule
repository step 13 is required to start with a fresh 113-package dependency, public-surface, fan-in, fan-out, central-LOC and CI-cost remeasurement
all semantically equivalent exception and bypass forms, including source-level lint suppressions, are required to be inventoried and governed
stable contract or SDK fan-out is distinguished from dangerous implementation or composition fan-out
blocking simplification budgets and representative developer change-cost proofs are required before step 13 can complete
repository step 13 remains not started and repository step 14 remains blocked
acceptance: the decision strengthens the existing 10/10 plan without changing repository order
the plan cannot treat the previous 110-package baseline as current 113-package completion evidence
unregistered source-level lint suppressions and equivalent bypasses are explicitly inside step-13 governance scope
dependency centralization or crate changes are forbidden until consumer roles and before-after complexity are measured
Customer Privacy and Phase 8A product readiness remain unchanged and incomplete
the final diff contains only the ADR, repository packet and generated active-packet document
non_goals: start repository step 13 implementation or any later repository step
change Rust code, dependency declarations, package count, public APIs, routes, contracts or runtime behavior
change CI workflows, affected-scope policy, architecture enforcement scripts or tests
remove or add architecture exceptions in this planning packet
claim architecture 10/10, Customer Privacy completion or Phase 8A completion
